home.title: Understand Islam through identifiable sources
home.body: Read published sources in your language where a translation exists, and turn suitable sources into short lessons a teacher reviews before sharing.
home.learnBody: Begin with a short, deliberate selection of first readings, or continue where you stopped.
home.libraryBody: The Quran with named published translations, an Arabic question-and-answer collection and hadith with their publisher's notes.
home.prepareBody: For teachers: choose a registered source, review the draft against it, then preview and download.

coverage: The interface has 7 languages; content coverage differs: the questions and answers are published in Arabic, with AI-assisted translations where one is stored; hadith translations vary by record; and Quran meanings come from six named published editions.
kinds: A published translation comes from its named publisher. An AI draft is unreviewed generated text. A local acknowledgment records only that a preparer on this device compared a draft with its source.

page.title: Start learning
page.intro: A small first-step selection from the library: two short surahs, a few clear published answers and hadith. Each step opens the full source.
page.noQuiz: Reading needs no quiz. A saved place shows where you stopped, not what you understood.
page.continueStale: Your saved place no longer matches the current source, so it is not offered.
page.error: First steps could not be loaded.
page.basis: An editorial reading order based on a model-assisted review of the full texts. It is not a curriculum and not a scholarly approval.
